question_text: The table below shows agricultural production volume (in metric tons) and value (in million pesos) for three crops across two regions. Region I: Rice volume 500, value 10,000; Corn volume 300, value 4,500; Coconut volume 200, value 3,000. Region II: Rice volume 400, value 8,000; Corn volume 350, value 5,250; Coconut volume 250, value 3,750. What is the total value of all crops in both regions?
